g.text: NUDGE • PHASE 10
Build from explicit contracts
Developer handoff · native parity and evidence gates, not a second product
Screen → component → API
Each screen maps to real discovery,
decision, account or tools contracts and
complete UI states.
Identity stays pinned
Keep user, privacy generation, revision and
intent body through pending writes. Review
again after conflicts; never rebase
silently.
Responsive by behavior
Wrap real content, preserve font scaling and
logical RTL spacing, virtualize long lists
and keep actions above safe areas.
Evidence before delivery claims
Rebuild and install the latest APK, exercise
real journeys, capture screenshots and
record remaining AI, push and store gates.
Design specification • Proposals and verification boundaries • Not an app screenshot
